headline: 97-Year-Old Wing Walker Breaks Record One Year After Stroke
meta_description: A 97-year-old former nurse reclaimed her Guinness World Record as the world's oldest female wing walker, performing a loop the loop just a year after suffering…
summary_short: A 97-year-old former nurse has broken her own Guinness World Record as the world's oldest female wing walker, performing a loop the loop to raise money for charity.
body:
A 97-year-old former nurse has reclaimed her Guinness World Record as the world's oldest female wing walker, performing a loop the loop in the process. The achievement is all the more remarkable given that she suffered a stroke just one year prior.

Wing walking—standing and performing aerobatic maneuvers on the exterior of an aircraft in flight—is an extreme sport typically associated with much younger participants. Her decision to return to the skies so soon after a major health setback demonstrates extraordinary resilience and determination.

Beyond the personal triumph, her record-breaking flight served a deeper purpose: raising money for a hospital. The dual achievement—reclaiming a title while advancing a charitable cause—transforms what could have been merely a daring stunt into a meaningful act of giving.

Broke her own Guinness World Record one year after stroke
Performed a loop the loop during the record-breaking flight
Raised money for hospital through the aerial performance
